players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Cal Raleigh placed on 10-day IL Thursday with a right oblique strain — first IL stint of his career in six MLB seasons. He aggravated the injury leaving Wednesday's game in the 8th inning. Imaging scheduled when the team returns to Seattle Friday; recovery outlook is 2–6 weeks.

sources.title: Mariners place Cal Raleigh on 10-day IL with right oblique strain

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper and the Phillies swept Boston at Fenway, winning 3-1 Thursday behind Jesus Luzardo's six scoreless innings and Kyle Schwarber's go-ahead two-run homer in the 8th. Harper drew a walk but was held hitless in the low-scoring affair.

sources.title: Schwarber's MLB-leading 18th homer lifts Phillies past Red Sox 3-1

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 1-for-2 with a walk and a stolen base as the Giants fell 5-2 at Dodger Stadium in the series finale. His leadoff single in the 4th was one of just two San Francisco hits off Emmet Sheehan.

sources.title: Giants vs Dodgers May 14 2026 box score

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-4 with a walk and two strikeouts as the Mets completed a three-game sweep of the Tigers 9-4. Nolan McLean was dominant with seven innings; Bichette was the lone Mets regular without a hit or RBI.

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle went 0-for-3 with two strikeouts against McLean but flashed his defensive brilliance with a jaw-dropping play to rob AJ Ewing of a hit. The Tigers were swept 9-4; McGonigle may be hitting the rookie wall after a fast start.

sources.title: Tigers vs Mets May 14 box score

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA walked and swiped his 11th base of the season in the 3rd inning but went hitless for the fourth straight game as the Cubs shutout the Braves 2-0 behind Ian Happ's homer and five combined pitchers.

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill sat out the Padres' series finale against LHP Kyle Harrison after going 2-for-22 over his last six games. The Padres dropped the game 7-1. He is expected back in the lineup Friday.

sources.title: Padres' Jackson Merrill not in Thursday's lineup

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernandez went 3-for-4 with a run and an RBI as the Dodgers salvaged a series split over the Giants 5-2. His third hit of the night chased Giants starter Landen Roupp with runners on 2nd and 3rd in the 6th — a strong bounce-back for the outfielder who had been pressing.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan and Alex Call lead Dodgers to series split vs Giants

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: The Yankees had an off day Thursday before beginning a road series at the Mets on Friday. Ben Rice is expected back in the lineup when New York resumes play.

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams did not appear in the Mets' 9-4 sweep-clincher with a comfortable lead and McLean going 7 innings. He carries six consecutive scoreless outings and a 43.5% whiff rate on his airbender changeup — up from 37.3% a year ago.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove in 2026

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler was not scheduled May 14. His May 12 start was historic: only 16 pitches through three innings (fewest since at least 2000), finishing with 7.1 IP, 1 ER in a 2-1 Phillies win at Fenway. Next turn projected ~May 17.

sources.title: Wheeler threw 16 pitches through three innings vs Red Sox

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans is on the 15-day IL (retroactive to May 7) with a left elbow impingement (valgus extension overload). He exited his last start after three innings with elbow tightness. A return before June appears unlikely; the Royals are still evaluating next steps.

sources.title: Royals place Cole Ragans on IL with elbow impingement

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns was dominant Thursday — 6 shutout innings, 7 Ks, 2 hits in Cincinnati's 15-1 demolition of the Nationals. He improved to 5-1 with his season ERA now at 2.05, having surrendered just one earned run over his last three starts combined.

sources.title: Reds get six shutout innings from Burns, rout Nationals 15-1

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi remains day-to-day after being scratched May 11 with left side tightness. He threw a bullpen session Wednesday and reported feeling good, targeting a start Sunday at Houston. The Rangers' medical staff will confirm before he returns.

sources.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi shares crucial injury update

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan turned in six strong innings — 2 R, 2 H, 6 Ks, 2 BB — as the Dodgers salvaged a 5-2 series split vs San Francisco. He improved to 3-1. Alex Call delivered the go-ahead RBI single, with Teoscar Hernandez setting the table with three hits.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan Dodgers salvage series split vs Giants

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers had an off day May 14; his start came May 13 at Cleveland where he took the loss (1-4) as Angel Martinez hit a leadoff homer in a 4-2 Guardians sweep-clinching win. The Angels were outscored 14-6 in the three-game series.

sources.title: Angel Martinez leads Guardians to sweep of Angels

injuries.name: Cal Raleigh
injuries.note: First IL stint of Raleigh's career. Aggravated right side in 8th inning of May 13 game. Imaging scheduled Friday. Recovery outlook 2-6 weeks; no official timetable set.

source.title: Mariners place Cal Raleigh on 10-day IL with right oblique strain

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: On IL since May 7 with valgus extension overload. Exited last start after 3 IP with elbow tightness. Return in June more likely than minimum window; team still evaluating.

source.title: Royals place Cole Ragans on IL with elbow impingement

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.note: Scratched May 11 vs ARI with left side tightness. Bullpen session May 13 went well. Targeting Sunday start vs HOU; medical staff sign-off still needed.

source.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi shares crucial injury update
